insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Associated medical expenses subject to proportionate deduction if higher room category chosen; no proportionate deduction for hospitals not following differential billing

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges all inclusive as provided by hospital

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay on every claim; waiver available on payment of additional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; modern treatments (robotic surgery, HIFU, etc.) capped at 50% of sum insured

initial_waiting.note: Applies to illness claims; accidents exempt; 90-day waiting for HIV/AIDS lump sum benefit

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for other pre-existing diseases; 90 days for HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions including cataract, hernia, hydrocele, varicose veins, benign tumors, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under Code Excl 18

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration or recharge benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses for 30 days prior to date of hospitalisation

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses for 60 days from date of discharge

day_care.note: All day care procedures explicitly covered

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary treatment benefit mentioned in the policy wording

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of sum insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: Covers robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, stem cell therapy etc., up to 50% of sum insured

consumables.note: Many consumables subsumed into room/procedure charges per the listed items; no separate consumables cover or rider offered

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except on grounds of fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for yearly premium mode; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, sterility/infertility, cosmetic surgery, gender change, obesity surgery, circumcision, external congenital anomalies, experimental therapies, EECP/chelation therapy

optional_riders.display: Waiver of 20% co-payment (available on additional premium)
